waves.create.quick.title: Start a chat wave
waves.create.quick.description: Give your wave a name and write the first post. You can review everything before creating it.
waves.create.quick.firstPostDescription: Tell people what this wave is for. This becomes its description and first post.
waves.create.quick.firstPostRequired: Write a first post or add media before continuing.
waves.create.quick.publicCreatorAdmin: Public wave: anyone can read it. Posting permissions are shown in the review. You are the administrator.
waves.create.quick.publicGroupAdmins: Public wave: anyone can read it. Posting permissions are shown in the review. Members of your selected administrator group can also manage this wave.
waves.create.quick.restrictedCreatorAdmi: Access is restricted. The selected groups and posting permissions are shown in the review. You are the administrator.
waves.create.quick.restrictedGroupAdmins: Access is restricted. The selected groups and posting permissions are shown in the review. Members of your selected administrator group can also manage this wave.
waves.create.quick.otherTypesSummary: Use the guided setup for Rank or Approve waves.
waves.create.quick.switchMessage: Changing type resets access, guidelines, and type-specific settings. Your name, picture, and first post will stay.
waves.create.quick.drafts: Text and settings are saved on this device for your current profile. Pictures and attachments must be added again. Older drafts contain settings only.
waves.create.quick.mediaOmitted: Add your picture and attachments again before creating this wave.
waves.create.quick.connectDescription: Connect your wallet, then choose a profile. We will bring you back here to start your wave.
waves.create.quick.successDescription: Your first post is published. Share the wave link to invite people.
waves.create.quick.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Use Share in the wave header.
